name: Patricia Lancaster
original_name: パトリシア・ランカスター
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 3rd year, Group A (Formerly: Minazuki Government Academy) / Former student council president
Favorite food: French fries
Gift: Only One Flower (The ability to seal gifts within a 10 meter field she creates. Within her personal space, she can designate which gifts to be sealed)

Patty is actually princess of a certain nation and was the former Student Council President of Minazuki Academy before [url=/c10098]Himeno[/url] took over. Her family specializes in making weapons, and the Light Saber she uses can even shoot beams.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
